title: Fig Leaf candle in a Dutch still life

tokens.v: Full-bleed photograph, edge to edge, no border. A Dutch still life on a dark oak table: the candle lit among split ripe figs, a fig branch with broad leaves, a pewter plate and a crumpled linen napkin, the background falling to deep brown-black. One soft window light from the left in the old-master manner. 70mm at table height, the candle label facing camera.
